#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <limits.h>

using namespace std;

struct Edge {
    int to, capacity, flow, cost;
    Edge(int to, int capacity, int flow, int cost) : to(to), capacity(capacity), flow(flow), cost(cost) {}
};

struct Pair {
    long first, second;
    Pair(long first, long second) : first(first), second(second) {}
    bool operator<(const Pair &other) const {
        if (first != other.first) return first < other.first;
        return second < other.second;
    }
};

struct MinCostFlow {
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    int source, destination;
    vector<long long> phi, dijkstraResult;
    vector<int> lastEdge;
    vector<int> visited;
    int visitIndex;
    MinCostFlow(int vertexCount) : graph(vertexCount), phi(vertexCount), dijkstraResult(vertexCount), lastEdge(vertexCount), visited(vertexCount) {}

    void fordBellman() {
        fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        phi[source] = 0;
        bool* inQueue = new bool[vertexCount];
        int* queue = new int[vertexCount + 1];
        queue[0] = source;
        inQueue[source] = true;
        int stepCount = 0;
        int head = 0;
        int end = 1;
        int maxSteps = 2 * vertexCount * vertexCount;
        while (head != end) {
            int vertex = queue[head++];
            if (head == queue[0] + 1) head = 0;
            inQueue[vertex] = false;
            int edgeID = 0;
            while (edgeID < graph[vertex].size()) {
                long total = phi[vertex] + graph[vertex][edgeID].cost;
                int destination = graph[vertex][edgeID].to;
                if (graph[vertex][edgeID].capacity != 0 && phi[destination] > total) {
                    phi[destination] = total;
                    if (!inQueue[destination]) {
                        queue[end++] = destination;
                        inQueue[destination] = true;
                        if (end == queue[0] + 1) end = 0;
                    }
                }
                edgeID++;
            }
        }
        delete[] inQueue;
        delete[] queue;
    }

    Pair<long long, long long> minCostMaxFlow() {
        return minCostMaxFlow(LLONG_MAX);
    }

    Pair<long long, long long> minCostMaxFlow(long long maxFlow) {
        long long cost = 0;
        long long flow = 0;
        while (maxFlow != 0) {
            dijkstraAlgorithm();
            if (lastEdge[destination] == -1) {
                return Pair<long long, long long>(cost, flow);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < dijkstraResult.size(); i++) {
                if (dijkstraResult[i] != LLONG_MAX) {
                    phi[i] += dijkstraResult[i];
                }
            }
            int vertex = destination;
            long long currentFlow = maxFlow;
            long long currentCost = 0;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                currentFlow = min(currentFlow, graph[vertex][edgeID].capacity - graph[vertex][edgeID].flow);
                currentCost += graph[vertex][edgeID].cost;
                vertex = graph[vertex][edgeID].to;
            }
            maxFlow -= currentFlow;
            cost += currentCost * currentFlow;
            flow += currentFlow;
            vertex = destination;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                graph[vertex][edgeID].flow += currentFlow;
                vertex = graph[vertex][edgeID].to;
            }
        }
        return Pair<long long, long long>(cost, flow);
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithm() {
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        priority_queue<Pair<long long, long long>, vector<Pair<long long, long long>>, greater<Pair<long long, long long>>> heap;
        heap.push(Pair<long long, long long>(0, source));
        while (!heap.empty()) {
            int current = heap.top().second;
            heap.pop();
            int edgeID = 0;
            while (edgeID < graph[current].size()) {
                if (graph[current][edgeID].capacity != 0) {
                    int next = graph[current][edgeID].to;
                    long long total = graph[current][edgeID].cost - phi[next] + phi[current] + dijkstraResult[current];
                    if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                        dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                        lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                        heap.push(Pair<long long, long long>(total, next));
                    }
                }
                edgeID++;
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithmFull() {
        visitIndex++;
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < graph.size(); i++) {
            int index = -1;
            long long length = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int j = 0; j < graph.size(); j++) {
                if (visited[j] != visitIndex && dijkstraResult[j] < length) {
                    length = dijkstraResult[j];
                    index = j;
                }
            }
            if (index == -1) {
                return;
            }
            visited[index] = visitIndex;
            int edgeID = 0;
            while (edgeID < graph[index].size()) {
                if (graph[index][edgeID].capacity != 0) {
                    int next = graph[index][edgeID].to;
                    if (visited[next] != visitIndex) {
                        long long total = graph[index][edgeID].cost - phi[next] + phi[index] + length;
                        if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                            dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                            lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                        }
                    }
                }
                edgeID++;
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    vector<int> cnt(26);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cnt[s[i] - 'a']++;
    }
    MinCostFlow mcmf(n + 100);
    int source = n + 100 - 2, target = source + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i * 2 < n; i++) {
        mcmf.graph[source].push_back(Edge(target, 0, 0, 2));
        mcmf.graph[target].push_back(Edge(source, 0, 0, -2));
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        mcmf.graph[source].push_back(Edge(i + n, 0, 0, 0));
        mcmf.graph[i + n].push_back(Edge(source, 0, 0, 0));
        for (int j = 0; j * 2 < n; j++) {
            if (s[j] == s[n - j - 1]) {
                int w = 0;
                if (s[j] == i + 'a') w = -max(a[j], a[n - j - 1]);
                mcmf.graph[i + n].push_back(Edge(j, w, 0, 1));
                mcmf.graph[j].push_back(Edge(i + n, -w, 0, 1));
            } else {
                int w = 0;
                if (s[j] == i + 'a') w -= a[j];
                if (s[n - j - 1] == i + 'a') w -= a[n - j - 1];
                mcmf.graph[i + n].push_back(Edge(j, w, 0, 1));
                mcmf.graph[j].push_back(Edge(i + n, -w, 0, 1));
            }
        }
    }
    mcmf.fordBellman();
    cout << -mcmf.minCostMaxFlow().first << endl;
    return 0;
}
